αἰδοῦς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve that restrains one before others; fem. gen. sg.
αἰδόμενος: αἴδομαι — feel shame, show regard, respect; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’out of respect, from delicacy’
αἰδὼς: αἰδώς — shame, a sense of respect or reserve; fem. nom. sg.
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, in this very way; adv. (ὣς δ’ αὔτως ’and in just the same way’)
βροτοῖσιν: βροτός — mortal, mortal man; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς)
γαιήοχε: γαιήοχος — earth-holder, earth-carrier (epithet of Poseidon); masc. voc. sg.; the verb behind -οχος (ἔχω ’hold’ or ὀχέω ’bear, carry’) is debated
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian (standing epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from Gerenia/Gerenon in Messenia, or linked to γέρων ’old man’ or γέρας ’honour’
γεραίτερον: γεραιός — old; comparative γεραίτερος ’older’; masc. acc. sg.
γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα); clasping the knees is the suppliant’s gesture
δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. nom./acc. sg.

δίου: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; standing epithet; masc. gen. sg.
δαίνυντ: δαίνυμι — feast, give a feast; mid. feast, partake; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented, elided (δαίνυντ’ = δαίνυντο)
δαίτης: δαίτη (epic by-form of δαίς) — feast, banquet; fem. gen. sg. (1st decl.; δαίς itself has gen. δαιτός)
δασσάμενοι: δατέομαι — divide, share out; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl., epic doubled σ (= Attic δασάμενοι)
δαῖτ: δαίς — feast, meal; acc. sg., elided (δαῖτ’ = δαῖτα)
δειδισκόμενος: δειδίσκομαι — greet, welcome, pledge (by holding out the cup); pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
δεῦρ: δεῦρο — hither, here; adv., elided (δεῦρ’ = δεῦρο)
δικαίῳ: δίκαιος — just, righteous (one who gives what is due); masc. dat. sg.
δυσμενέεσσιν: δυσμενής — hostile, ill-disposed; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic -έσι)
δὸς: δίδωμι — give, grant; aor. imper. 2 sg.
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκε)

εἰπέμεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰπεῖν)

εἴθ: εἴτε — whether, or; correlative conj., elided and aspirated (εἴθ’ = εἴτε)
εἴρεαι: εἴρομαι — ask; pres. 2 sg., epic by-form of ἔρομαι, uncontracted ending (= Attic ἔρῃ)
εἴτε: εἴτε — whether, or; correlative conj. (εἴτε ... εἴτε ’whether ... or’)
εὐχομένοισι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; pres. part. masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
εὔξεαι: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; aor. subj. 2 sg., short-vowel, uncontracted ending (= Attic εὔξῃ)
εὔχεο: εὔχομαι — pray; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὔχου)

θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
θαρσήσας: θαρσέω — take courage, be bold; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken courage’
θνητοῖσι: θνητός — mortal; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
θοῇ: θοός — swift, quick (standing epithet of ships); fem. dat. sg.
θρασυμήδεϊ: Θρασυμήδης — Thrasymedes, son of Nestor; masc. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -εϊ (= Attic -ει)
θῆχ: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided and aspirated (θῆχ’ = θῆκε)
κάλλιόν: καλός — beautiful, fine; comparative κάλλιον, neut. nom./acc. sg. used predicatively: ’more fitting’
κέκευθε: κεύθω — cover, hide, conceal; perf. 3 sg. with pres. sense: ’holds hidden’
κέλευθα: κέλευθος — path, way, course; neut. nom./acc. pl. κέλευθα, epic by-form beside fem. sg. κέλευθος
κατάγοντο: κατάγω — bring down, bring to land; mid. put in to shore; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= κατήγοντο)
καταλέξω: καταλέγω — recount in full and in order; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg. (the epic forms coincide): ’I will tell in full’
κλῦθι: κλύω — hear, listen; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’hear!’ (regular opening of a prayer)
κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
κρέ: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρέ’ = κρέα)
κυανοχαίτῃ: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (epithet of Poseidon, from κύανος ’dark blue-black’ + χαίτη ’flowing hair’); masc. dat. sg.
κύθε: κεύθω — cover, hide; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκυθε)
κύμασιν: κῦμα — wave, billow; neut. dat. pl.
κώεσιν: κῶας — fleece, sheepskin; neut. dat. pl.
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. nom./acc. sg.
λίμνην: λίμνη — mere, standing water, lake; fem. acc. sg.
λίσσεσθαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. inf. used imperativally: ’beseech (him)!’
ληιστῆρες: ληιστήρ — plunderer, pirate, freebooter; masc. nom. pl.
λιπὼν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having left’
λυγρὸν: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc. acc. sg.
μαλακοῖσιν: μαλακός — soft; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
μαρνάμενον: μάρναμαι — fight, do battle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
μεγήρῃς: μεγαίρω — grudge, begrudge; aor. subj. 2 sg., in a prohibition with μηδέ: ’do not begrudge’
μειλίσσεο: μειλίσσω — soothe, make mild, soften; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic μειλίσσου)
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα
μελιηδέος: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; masc./neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic μελιηδοῦς)
μετέρχομαι: μετέρχομαι — go after, seek, pursue; pres. 1 sg.
μεταλλῆσαι: μεταλλάω — inquire, ask about; aor. inf.
μηδέ: μηδέ — and not, nor, do not; neg. conj., used to forbid before an imperative
μηρί: μηρίον — thigh-piece, burned as an offering; neut. acc. pl., elided (μηρί’ = μηρία)
μνῆσαι: μιμνήσκω — remind; mid. remember, be mindful; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’remember!’
μοίρας: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. acc. pl.
μολόντες: βλώσκω (aor. ἔμολον) — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
μύθοισι: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, craft, counsel; fem. acc. sg.
νέστορ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. voc. sg.
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
νεώτερός: νέος — young; comparative νεώτερος ’younger’; masc. nom. sg.
νηληϊάδη: Νηληϊάδης — son of Neleus (patronymic of Nestor); masc. voc. sg.
νηλῆος: Νηλεύς — Neleus, father of Nestor; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’the unerring truth’
νοήσεις: νοέω — perceive, think of, devise; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will think of’
ξείνους: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. acc. pl.

οὕνεκα: οὕνεκα (crasis of οὗ ἕνεκα) — because; also relative: for the sake of which, for which reason; conj.
πάρ: παρά — beside, along; prep. + dat., epic apocope πάρ (= παρά)
πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they tasted’
πάσχετε: πάσχω — suffer, experience; impf. 2 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπάσχετε)
πήματ: πῆμα — woe, suffering, calamity; neut. acc. pl., elided (πήματ’ = πήματα)
παλλάδ: Παλλάς — Pallas, title of Athena; fem. acc. sg., elided (Παλλάδ’ = Παλλάδα)
πεισίστρατος: Πεισίστρατος — Peisistratus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
πελάγει: πέλαγος — the open sea; neut. dat. sg.
πεντακόσιοι: πεντακόσιοι — five hundred; numeral adj., masc. nom. pl.

πλεῖθ: πλέω — sail; pres. 2 pl., elided and aspirated (πλεῖθ’ = πλεῖτε): ’do you sail?’
πολέμιζον: πολεμίζω — fight, wage war; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπολέμιζον), + dat.: ’fought against’
πολύχαλκον: πολύχαλκος — rich in bronze, of much bronze (epithet of the sky); masc. acc. sg.
ποσείδαον: Ποσειδῶν (epic Ποσειδάων) — Poseidon; masc. voc. sg., accent thrown back
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
πρήξαντα: πρήσσω (Attic πράσσω) — do, accomplish, achieve; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic πράξαντα): ’having accomplished (it)’
προσπτύξομαι: προσπτύσσομαι — greet warmly, embrace, address; fut. 1 sg. or aor. subj. 1 sg., short-vowel (= προσπτύξωμαι): ’shall I greet?’
προτέρη: πρότερος — before, first, earlier; fem. nom. sg., predicative: ’first, before (him)’, Ionic η (= Attic προτέρα)

πρῆξιν: πρῆξις (Attic πρᾶξις) — business, undertaking, transaction; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
πρῆξις: πρῆξις (Attic πρᾶξις) — business, errand, undertaking; fem. nom. sg., Ionic η
πυλίοισιν: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
πυλίων: Πύλιος — Pylian, of Pylos; masc. gen. pl.
πύθηαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn, inquire, find out; aor. subj. 2 sg., uncontracted ending (= Attic πύθῃ)
σπείσῃς: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. subj. 2 sg.
σπεῖσαι: σπένδω — pour a libation; aor. inf.: ’to pour a libation’
σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.

στεῖλαν: στέλλω — equip, make ready; of sails, furl, take in; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔστειλαν)
σύμπασιν: σύμπας — all together, all in a body; masc. dat. pl.
σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (knees)’
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τάρπησαν: τέρπω — delight, satisfy; aor. pass. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐτάρπησαν), + gen.: ’had their fill of’
τελεύτα: τελευτάω — bring to an end, accomplish, fulfil; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτελεύτα)
τεοῖσιν: τεός (epic possessive = σός) — your, yours; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic σοῖς)

τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τραφέμεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; intr. aor. inf. τραφέμεν, epic -έμεν (= Attic τραφῆναι): ’to grow up, be reared’
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
υἱάσι: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ- (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
υἱάσιν: υἱός — son; masc. dat. pl., epic stem υἱ-, ν-movable (= Attic υἱοῖς/υἱέσι)
φαείνοι: φαείνω — shine, give light; pres. opt. 3 sg., purpose after a past tense: ’so that he might shine’
χαρίεσσαν: χαρίεις — graceful, pleasing, gracious; fem. acc. sg. χαρίεσσαν
χατέουσ: χατέω — need, lack, stand in want of; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted, elided (χατέουσ’ = χατέουσι), + gen.
χρυσείῳ: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted -είῳ (= Attic -ῷ)
χρύσειον: χρύσεος (Attic χρυσοῦς) — golden; masc./neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted -ειον (= Attic -οῦν)
ψεῦδος: ψεῦδος — falsehood, lie; neut. acc. sg.
ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.
ἀγακλειτῆς: ἀγακλειτός — very glorious, famed; fem. gen. sg.
ἀθηναίην: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. acc. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)

ἀμοιβὴν: ἀμοιβή — return, exchange, recompense; fem. acc. sg.
ἀμφικύπελλον: ἀμφικύπελλος — meaning disputed: usually taken as ’double’ (a cup with a bowl at each end), also explained as ’two-handled’; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δέπας
ἀμφιτρίτης: Ἀμφιτρίτη — Amphitrite, a sea-goddess, sometimes standing for the sea itself; fem. gen. sg.
ἀνόρουσε: ἀνορούω — spring up, leap up; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἀνώρουσε)
ἀπευθέα: ἀπευθής — unlearned, not found out, unascertained; masc. acc. sg.

ἄγυρίν: ἄγυρις — gathering, assembly (old form of ἀγορά); fem. acc. sg.
ἄκουσας: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 2 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσας), + gen. of source
ἄλεισον: ἄλεισον — goblet, cup; neut. acc. sg.
ἄλλοισι: ἄλλος — other; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.

ἐξαλαπάξαι: ἐξαλαπάζω — sack utterly, raze; aor. inf.

ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
ἔκαιον: καίω — burn; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were burning’

ἰδ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj., elided (ἰδ’ = ἰδέ)

ἱκόμεσθα: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. 1 pl. mid., epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’we came’
ἱπποδάμοιο: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming (standing epithet); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἱππότα: ἱππότης — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α
ἴω: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 sg., deliberative: ’am I to go?’
ἵδρυσεν: ἱδρύω — seat, set, establish; aor. 3 sg.: ’seated (them)’
ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
ὀιζυρὸν: ὀιζυρός — wretched, full of misery; masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’(bore him) to be wretched’
ὀπωπῆς: ὀπωπή — sight, act of seeing; fem. gen. sg.
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὁμηλικίη: ὁμηλικίη — those of the same age, age-mates; fem. nom. sg., used predicatively of one person: ’he is my age-mate’
ὁππόθ: ὁππόθι — where; epic indirect interrog. adv., elided (ὁππόθ’ = ὁππόθι before a smooth breathing; before a rough breathing ὁππόθ’ could also be ὁππότε ’when’, aspirated)
ὄλωλεν: ὄλλυμι — destroy; perf. 3 sg. intr.: ’has perished, is lost’
ὄπαζε: ὀπάζω — grant, bestow, give as a companion; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’grant!’
ὄπωπας: ὁράω — see; perf. 2 sg.: ’you have seen’
ὑγρὰ: ὑγρός — wet, fluid, liquid; neut. acc. pl.
ὑπέρτερα: ὑπέρτερος — higher, upper; neut. acc. pl., of meat: ’the upper (outer) flesh’
ὑπεὶρ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + acc., epic lengthened by-form ὑπείρ
ὑποθήσεται: ὑποτίθημι — put under; mid. suggest, advise, prompt; fut. mid. 3 sg.
ὑπονηίου: ὑπονήιος — under (Mount) Neion; masc./fem. gen. sg.; which height the name belongs to, and whether it is Ithaca’s own, is uncertain
ὑποστὰς: ὑφίστημι — place under; intr. (aor. 2 act. and mid.) undertake, promise; aor. 2 part. act. masc. nom. sg., intr.: ’having promised’
ὤπτων: ὀπτάω — roast; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were roasting’
ὥρμισαν: ὁρμίζω — moor, bring to anchor; aor. 3 pl.: ’they moored (her)’
ῥέζον: ῥέζω — do, perform; of sacrifice, ἱερὰ ῥέζειν ’offer sacrifice’; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔρρεζον)

__broaden__.τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’)
__broaden__.καλὸν: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; masc. acc. sg. (agreeing with a noun) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’beautifully’ (with an infinitive) · also neut. acc. sg. used as a noun, direct object: ’a fine one’ (μάλα καλὸν ἑλών) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive, agreeing with a stated neut. noun: ’fine’ (καλὸν δέπας ’the fine cup’)
__broaden__.λίσσομαι: λίσσομαι — beseech, entreat; pres. 1 sg., + gen. of the power invoked · also + acc. of the person entreated (and acc. of the thing asked): οὐχ ὑμέας ἔτι λίσσομαι ’I no longer beg you’ · also used absolutely, the addressee already given by context and left unexpressed, with the ground of the appeal in a following clause (λίσσομαι, εἴ ποτέ ...)
__broaden__.ἥν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.) · also relative + indefinite, in the compound ἥν τινα = ἥτις (fem.): ’whatever, what’
__broaden__.τίνες: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. pl., predicate of an infinitive · also predicate of a finite verb (εἰμί): τίνες ἐστέ; ’who are you?’
__broaden__.κίε: κίω — go, go one’s way; aor. 3 sg. (root aorist, unaugmented): ’went’ (the gen. Τηλεμάχοιο is governed by ἰθύς ’straight toward’, not by this verb) · also imper. 2 sg.: ’go!’
__broaden__.ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
__broaden__.τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’)
__broaden__.οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
__broaden__.τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
__broaden__.νέον: νέος — new, young; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’newly, for the first time’ · also masc. acc. sg., ’young’ (νέον ἄνδρα ’a young man’)
__broaden__.εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’wide’ (κλέος εὐρύ ’wide fame’)
__broaden__.νημερτέα: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted · also neut. acc. pl., uncontracted, used as a noun: ’unerring things, the truth’
__broaden__.βαῖν: βαίνω — go, walk, step; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βαῖν’ = βαῖνε), tmesis ἀνέβαινε ’was going aboard’ · also in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐκβαίνω ’was stepping out’
__broaden__.ἰθὺς: ἰθύς — straight; prep. + gen. (epic = Attic εὐθύς): ’straight towards’ · also adv., no case expressed: ’straight, straight on’
__broaden__.πυκινοῖσιν: πυκινός — close-packed, tightly-stitched, close; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οῖς) · also masc. dat. pl.; of words and thoughts, ’shrewd, well-knit’
__broaden__.χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, it is right; impersonal verb + acc. and inf. · also + acc. of the person and gen. of the thing: ’there is need of’
__broaden__.μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
__broaden__.ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
__broaden__.ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
__broaden__.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
